  SELECT

WITH inv AS (

SELECT

  SUM(CASE WHEN d.doc_type = 'cr' THEN d.amt_usd ELSE 0 END) as cr_usd,

  SUM(CASE WHEN d.doc_type = 'inv' THEN d.amt_usd 
           WHEN d.doc_type = 'cr' THEN -d.amt_usd 
           WHEN d.doc_type = 'canc' THEN d.amt_usd ELSE 0 END) as net_rev_usd
FROM (
  SELECT 'inv' as doc_type, i.inv_id as doc_id, i.inv_dt as dt, i.curr_cd, i.inv_tot_amt,
         i.inv_tot_amt * COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) as amt_usd, h.xbrdr_flg
